title: Resume Rewrite Engine Output (10-section A-J)
description: 10-section structured rewrite product produced by harness.rewrite.engine (Wave 4 D.2a). Mirrors packages/strategy-modules/resume-rewrite-engine/output-schema.md but flattened to snake_case keys for the harness layer. This schema asserts top-level shape only; per-section content rules are enforced upstream by the LLM prompts and downstream by Pass 3 (D.4).

section_a_fit_diagnosis.description: Fit diagnosis prose (1-6 sentences). Honest, specific, lens-aware.

section_b_priority_signals.description: Priority signals for the top-half of page one. Items: {name, where, why}.

section_c_experience_prioritization.description: 4-category bucketing of experiences (must_lead_and_expand / keep_but_compress / retain_as_supporting_signal / downgrade_or_remove). Each bucket is a list of experience_ids.

section_e_cross_company_variations.description: Cross-company consensus / variations. D.2a is single-JD MVP; this section is a stub.

section_f_section_by_section_guidance.description: Per-section keep/cut/emphasize decisions. D.2a leaves this as a stub; future waves populate.

section_g_bullets.description: Rewritten bullets for retained experiences (Cat 1/2/3). Each item: {id, text, claimed_facts, experience_id, final_category, disambiguator_parenthetical?}.

section_h_resume_structure.description: Resume structure recommendation (section ordering, summary inclusion, skills handling). D.2a stub.

section_i_final_resume_draft.description: Plain-text final resume draft consumed by the LaTeX renderer. D.2a leaves this empty; loop wiring (D.2b) merges Section G into the master template.

section_j_decision_log.description: Per-experience decision entries. D.2a minimal stub: {experience_id, decision, rationale}.

_method.description: How this output was produced. 'llm' = full LLM-driven rewrite; 'llm_partial' = some LLM responses recovered with best-effort defaults; 'fallback_no_llm' = LLM transport failure (timeout / circuit / connection); 'skipped_tier_1' = tier_assigned == 1; engine deliberately did no work.
